Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome operations {#operations}

Inspect OpenAPI operations for a project version.

```text
apiome operations [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`show`](#operations-show).

## apiome operations show {#operations-show}

Show one operation with parameters, bodies, and responses.

```text
apiome operations show [OPTIONS] OPERATION_REF
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OPERATION_REF` | text | yes | Path operation UUID or OpenAPI operationId. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project UUID or slug. |
| `--version` | text |  | yes | Version UUID, slug, or label. |
| `--tag` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Narrow lookup by OpenAPI tag (repeatable). |
| `--method` | text (repeatable) |  |  | Narrow lookup by HTTP method (repeatable). |
